entry.title: dj-analyze Memory-Safety Configuration: batch/block/prefetch/streaming & Ray DataContext
entry.content:
Overview

When running dj-analyze (Data-Juicer's analysis sub-command) on large datasets — especially with Ray as the execution backend — several memory-safety related configuration knobs control how data is loaded, buffered, and processed. This post documents those options across four categories: batch, block, prefetch, and streaming.

1. Batch Configuration

Batch-level options control how many rows are processed together in each worker call. Options include --batch_size, --adaptive_batch_size (visible in dj-analyze --help), and Ray DataContext's target_max_block_size (not exposed as a CLI flag).

2. Block (Ray Dataset) Configuration

Ray's Dataset abstraction partitions data into blocks. Key options: DataContext.target_max_block_size (default 512 MiB), target_min_block_size, and block_splitting_enabled.

3. Prefetch Configuration

Set DataContext.prefetch_blocks = 0 to disable speculative prefetching and reduce memory usage on constrained machines.

4. Streaming / Lazy Execution Configuration

Use use_cache: false in Data-Juicer YAML and configure DataContext.execution_options for streaming execution.

5. Troubleshooting

5.1 dj-analyze --help | grep -i batch shows --adaptive_batch_size but NOT Ray DataContext options. This is expected: DataContext is a Ray runtime singleton, not a CLI argument. Use a Python launcher wrapper to set DataContext before calling Data-Juicer.

5.2 To locate Ray DataContext usage in a checked-out repo, run from the repo root (the directory containing data_juicer/): grep -rn "DataContext" data_juicer/ --include="*.py"

5.3 Directory name confusion: data-juicer (hyphen, repo/pip name) ≠ data_juicer (underscore, importable Python package). The grep target must always use the underscore form. Running grep from the wrong directory causes No such file or directory errors unrelated to the code itself.
entry.summary: Documents memory-safety related configuration options for dj-analyze / Data-Juicer (batch/block/prefetch/streaming). Covers the --adaptive_batch_size CLI flag, Ray DataContext options not exposed in --help, a script to locate DataContext usage in a checked-out repo, and notes on directory name confusion when running grep.
